text_en: After Jesus had spoken these words, he looked up to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come; glorify your Son so that the Son may glorify you,
text_cn: 耶稣讲完了这些话，便举目向天说：“父啊！时辰来到了，求你光荣你的子，好叫子也光荣你：

text_en: since you have given him authority over all people, to give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
text_cn: 因为你赐给了他权柄掌管凡有血肉的人，是为叫他将永生赐给一切你所赐给他的人。

text_en: And this is eternal life, that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent.
text_cn: 永生就是：认识你，唯一的真天主，和你所派遣来的耶稣基督。

text_en: I glorified you on earth by finishing the work that you gave me to do.
text_cn: 我在地上，已光荣了你，完成了你所委托我所作的工作。

text_en: So now, Father, glorify me in your own presence with the glory that I had in your presence before the world existed.
text_cn: 父啊！现在，在你面前光荣我罢！赐给我在世界未有以前，我在你前所有的光荣罢！”

text_en: “I have made your name known to those whom you gave me from the world. They were yours, and you gave them to me, and they have kept your word.
text_cn: “我将你的名，已显示给那些你由世界中所赐给我的人。他们原属于你，你把他们托给了我，他们也遵守了你的话。

text_en: Now they know that everything you have given me is from you;
text_cn: 现在，他们已知道：凡你赐给我的，都是由你而来的，

text_en: for the words that you gave to me I have given to them, and they have received them and know in truth that I came from you; and they have believed that you sent me.
text_cn: 因为你所授给我的话，我都传给了他们；他们也接受了，也确实知道我是出于你，并且相信是你派遣了我。

text_en: I am asking on their behalf; I am not asking on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those whom you gave me, because they are yours.
text_cn: 我为他们祈求，不为世界祈求，只为你赐给我的人祈求，因为他们原是属于你的。

text_en: All mine are yours, and yours are mine; and I have been glorified in them.
text_cn: 我的一切都是你的，你的一切都是我的：我因他们已受到了光荣。

text_en: And now I am no longer in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, protect them in your name that you have given me, so that they may be one, as we are one.
text_cn: 从今以后，我不在世界上了，但他们仍在世界上，我却到你那里去。圣父啊！求你因你的名，保全那些你所赐给我的人，使他们合而为一，正如我们一样。

text_en: While I was with them, I protected them in your name that you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost except the one destined to be lost, so that the scripture might be fulfilled.
text_cn: 当我和他们同在时，我因你的名，保全了你所赐给我的人，护卫了他们，其中除了那丧亡之子，没有丧亡一个，这是为应验经上的话。

text_en: But now I am coming to you, and I speak these things in the world so that they may have my joy made complete in themselves.
text_cn: 但如今我到你那里去，我在世上讲这话，是为叫他们的心充满我的喜乐。

text_en: I have given them your word, and the world has hated them because they do not belong to the world, just as I do not belong to the world.
text_cn: 我已将你的话授给了他们，世界却憎恨他们，因为他们不属于世界，就如我不属于世界一样。

text_en: I am not asking you to take them out of the world, but I ask you to protect them from the evil one.
text_cn: 我不求你将他们从世界上撤去，只求你保护他们脱免邪恶。

text_en: They do not belong to the world, just as I do not belong to the world.
text_cn: 他们不属于世界，就如我不属于世界一样。

text_en: Sanctify them in the truth; your word is truth.
text_cn: 求你以真理祝圣他们；你的话就是真理。

text_en: As you have sent me into the world, so I have sent them into the world.
text_cn: 就如你派遣我到世界上来，照样我也派遣他们到世界上去。

text_en: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, so that they also may be sanctified in truth.
text_cn: 我为他们祝圣我自己，为叫他们也因真理而被祝圣。”

text_en: “I ask not only on behalf of these, but also on behalf of those who will believe in me through their word,
text_cn: “我不但为他们祈求，而且也为那些因他们的话而信从我的人祈求。

text_en: that they may all be one. As you, Father, are in me and I am in you, may they also be in us, so that the world may believe that you have sent me.
text_cn: 愿众人都合而为一！父啊！愿他们在我们内合而为一，就如你在我内，我在你内，为叫世界相信是你派遣了我。

text_en: The glory that you have given me I have given them, so that they may be one, as we are one,
text_cn: 我将你赐给我的光荣赐给了他们，为叫他们合而为一，就如我们原为一体一样。

text_en: I in them and you in me, that they may become completely one, so that the world may know that you have sent me and have loved them even as you have loved me.
text_cn: 我在他们内，你在我内，使他们完全合而为一，为叫世界知道是你派遣了我，并且你爱了他们，如爱了我一样。

text_en: Father, I desire that those also, whom you have given me, may be with me where I am, to see my glory, which you have given me because you loved me before the foundation of the world.
text_cn: 父啊！你所赐给我的人，我愿我在哪里，他们也同我在一起，使他们享见你所赐给我的光荣，因为你在创世之前，就爱了我。

text_en: “Righteous Father, the world does not know you, but I know you; and these know that you have sent me.
text_cn: 公义的父啊！世界没有认识你，我却认识了你，这些人也知道是你派遣了我。

text_en: I made your name known to them, and I will make it known, so that the love with which you have loved me may be in them, and I in them. ”
text_cn: 我已经将你的名宣示给他们了，我还要宣示，好使你爱我的爱，在他们内，我也在他们内。”
